Theorem
[Margulis lemma, local form] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0208 1. ch31:31.38\group Margulis lemma

For $0<\varepsilon \le \varepsilon _n$, the ball of radius $\varepsilon /2$ is isometric to the corresponding quotient by the subgroup generated by loops of length at most $\varepsilon $; that subgroup is trivial, infinite cyclic, or a discrete free Euclidean isometry group.
